notes: The addon gets one window: /wfd, the button at the minimap or a key. Pages Now, Farm, Runs, Craft, Lists, Tools and Settings; switches instead of chat commands.
Farm sessions start by themselves at the first loot outside towns, pause after 5 minutes without loot and end after 20. They count experience an hour and the time to the next level.
A bar on the screen while you farm, and a card with what the session gave when it ends.
The window says when the app last sent its data and what of this session it has not got yet.
Coins from corpses are counted with auto loot too: until now most of them were missed.
